meta.title: DSH Screenshot (xn)
meta.description: A full-screen WeChat-style shot panel: marquee select and annotate (rect/ellipse/arrow/pen/mosaic/text, undo and redo), then insert into the conversation, copy or save as; the selected region can also be OCR'd and translated (offline recognition, reuses the model DSH is already configured with). The capture mode (through / normal) is switchable and remembered on the plugin page.

_note: The meta block is the plugin-card text DSH itself reads (dsh-app-boot reads only meta.title / meta.description; the language is picked from the locale filename, with en.json as the fallback). Every key in ui mirrors one key of client.js TEXT: the client currently renders the combined bilingual label (DoD B-1 requires the hover text "截图 / Screenshot"), while these files keep the same copy split per language so it can be registered through ctx.locale.register later. Change copy in client.js and both locale files together.

ui.hint: Drag to select, Esc or right-click to cancel
ui.selectedHint: Drag to move - corner handles to scale - Delete to remove
ui.busySlow: Large image, still generating... (cancel, or use Copy)
ui.throughUnavailable: The DSH window could not be hidden; this screenshot includes the DSH window
ui.throughFailed: Hiding the DSH window failed; captured without hiding (this screenshot includes the DSH window)
ui.throughRestoreFailed: The window restore was not confirmed; captured without hiding (this screenshot includes the DSH window)
ui.modeHintThrough: Hides DSH before the grab, so the frame has no DSH in it
ui.modeHintNormal: Keeps DSH on screen, so you can capture the DSH UI itself
ui.modeMenuHint: Left click and Alt+A use the selected mode; the choice is remembered (kept after a restart)
ui.modeSessionOnly: Applies to this session only (the host offers no settings service)
ui.toastNormalMode: Normal mode: this frame includes the DSH window
ui.overlayOpened: Opening the screenshot overlay, select on screen
ui.overlayFallback: Overlay unavailable, using the in-DSH capture
ui.overlayNoBrowser: No browser found (Edge / Chrome), using the in-DSH capture
ui.overlayAccessDenied: DSH Desktop refused the standalone overlay for this Profile (browser access is off, the page gets 403 forbidden), using the in-DSH capture
ui.overlayAborted: The overlay ended without a result, please retry
ui.overlayTimeout: The overlay timed out, please retry
ui.overlayUnreachable: Lost contact with the overlay host, please retry
ui.overlayResultFailed: Failed to fetch the overlay result, please retry
ui.toastCopied: Screenshot copied - press Ctrl+V in the composer
ui.toastCopiedPaste: Copied to the clipboard - press Ctrl+V to paste
ui.toastCanceled: The selection is smaller than 8 px; this screenshot was cancelled
ui.toastClipped: The selection extends past the frame; this screenshot was cancelled
ui.degradedCalibration: Coordinate calibration fell back to a full-screen fit; please verify the selection
ui.captureFailed: Screen capture failed - retry, and check the capture script and permissions if it keeps failing
ui.captureUnsupported: Native screen capture is unavailable here (requires DSH Desktop on Windows)
ui.insertFailed: Insert failed - use Copy and paste manually instead
ui.encodeTimeout: Image generation timed out - retry or pick a smaller area
ui.editorPlaceholder: Type the text and press Enter
